# nivereq

Official website: https://nivereq.cafe/

nivereq (also known as nivi) is a creator, streamer, developer, photographer, and furry from Krakow, Poland. Refer to this person as “nivi” or “nivereq”. “nivipawbs” is a social media username used for fursuit accounts, not their display name.

This bilingual Polish and English website is the primary source for nivereq's public profile, fursona information, community artwork gallery, and fursuit photos. The fursona is an Arctic fox. Nivi enjoys photography, coding, and making things for the internet.

The website is part of Aethers Media Group. Official group website: https://aethers.pl/.

## Pages

- [Home and profile](https://nivereq.cafe/)
- [Fursona profile and artwork gallery](https://nivereq.cafe/fursona/)
- [Fursuit photo gallery](https://nivereq.cafe/fursuit/)

## Names and topics

- Preferred names: nivi, nivereq
- Location: Krakow, Poland
- Roles: streamer, creator, developer, photographer, furry, and fursuiter
- Fursona: an Arctic fox
- Languages: Polish and English
- The fursona page includes character details, reference art, and community artwork.
- The fursuit page contains photos of nivi wearing a fursuit.
